content.short: Rent Tycoon is a Telegram tycoon game where players use TON to buy RENT and virtual tower pixels that generate in-game income.
content.description: Rent Tycoon is a Telegram game inspired by real-estate tycoon and Monopoly-style mechanics. The site describes players buying RENT with TON, purchasing pixels in virtual towers, and collecting ongoing RENT income from those spaces. Its TON connection is built into the game economy, while the main user experience is casual tycoon gameplay inside Telegram. Rent Tycoon - Новая тап игра с доходом в TON!.
